submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 gives the highest simulated signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocation at 35 GeV: 92.1%, against 85.5% for L3 and 73.4% for L2. This matches the 2025 summary. I only simulated 35 GeV and did not scan other thresholds. The 4.0 us latency limit is a hard requirement, and no project document gives latency figures for any candidate. The simulation tool doesn't report latency either. The L1 recommendation is therefore provisional. Someone must confirm L1's FPGA latency is 4.0 us or less before adopting it. Iterative clustering is plausibly the slowest of the three. If L1 fails the check, the fallback is L3, and its latency must also be verified. L2 is the last resort because it is the simplest design.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm is one of the three candidates
Latency on L1 FPGA hardware <= 4.0 us (hard)
requirements.evidence: No document or tool output gives latency for any candidate. This needs verification from firmware or synthesis numbers.

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at allocated rate (8 kHz)
